purpose: Over-representation enrichment across a Tartary buckwheat study's differential-expression contrasts and WGCNA modules: three contrasts (blue-light vs dark, young fruit vs leaf, mature fruit vs leaf; padj < 0.05 and |lfc| > 1, direction-split UP/DOWN) and 13 WGCNA modules, each tested for GO, KEGG pathway and KO terms (26 runs) with the hypergeometric upper tail and Benjamini-Hochberg correction. The gene universe is the ID-bridge-mapped, annotated subset (GO 14,944 / KO 13,912 / KEGG 8,929 genes); term descriptions come from go-basic.obo and rest.kegg.jp.

methodology.backends_flag: linxira-bio enrichment custom (Rust hypergeometric + BH), one run per gene set, 8 threads pinned
methodology.repeat_flag: 1 per gene set and term type
methodology.disclosure: wall times are per-run engine time; at this scale the runs are CPU-trivial and the value is determinism and schema-checked outputs, not speed

environment.cpu_model: Intel Xeon E5-2676 v3 @ 2.40GHz (24 threads; runs pinned to cores 8-15, nice 10)
environment.gpu: AMD Radeon RX 580 2048SP (Polaris 20, amdgpu kernel driver; unused by these workloads)
environment.memory: 32 GiB DDR3-1600 MT/s (2x16 GiB DIMM_B1/D1, 72-bit width)
environment.storage: system/log: Kingston SA400S37 120 GB SSD; benchmark I/O data volume: WDC WD5000AZLX 500 GB 7200rpm HDD; bulk reference data: Seagate ST3000DM001 3 TB HDD
environment.code_revision: v1.0.3 release binary (workstation deployment, built 2026-09-14) + post-release ops scripts

data_sources.reference: eggNOG-mapper v2 annotation of the study proteome (27,981 genes; GO / KEGG_ko / KEGG_Pathway columns)
data_sources.note: ID bridge: GWHTBJBL/GWHPBJBL shared 6-digit tail, 27,908/33,955 mapped, zero duplicate tails

data_sources.reference: differential-expression outputs for the study's contrasts (public SRA underneath); significance padj < 0.05 and |lfc| > 1
WGCNA module assignments: 24-sample network (11 modules) and 8-sample network (2 modules)
data_sources.note: module membership mapped through the same ID bridge

data_sources.reference: go-basic.obo (geneontology.org) and rest.kegg.jp KO/pathway name lists
data_sources.note: descriptions embedded in the association tables
